title: Ultramarine Blue
content: Why does the Madonna traditionally wear blue?In the Renaissance, blue was reserved for the mother of Jesus because it was the rarest color, more expensive than gold. Originally it was made fromlapis lazuli,a mineral mined in Afghanistan. Getting a supply required a long voyageultramarinus,or "beyond the sea."Contracts for paintings often stipulated that the artist use ultramarine, and sometimes the client was required to provide the rare pigment.A synthetic ultramarine pigment was developed in 1826.
